SYMPTOM: '-[UIInputViewController needsInputModeSwitchKey] was called before a connection was established to the host application. This will produce an inaccurate result.'
CAUSE: Called in viewDidLoad (too early — no host connection) and even viewDidAppear fires before connection on spurious/cold launches
FIX: Move into the 0.3s deferred DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter block in viewDidAppear:
```swift
DispatchQueue.main.asyncAfter(deadline: .now() + 0.3) { [weak self] in
    guard let self else { return }
    self.keyboardView.showGlobe = self.needsInputModeSwitchKey
    self.checkPendingTranscription()
    self.startRelayPolling()
    self.reportKeyboardStatus()
    self.refreshVoiceStrip()
}
```
Since showGlobe setter only toggles isHidden (not rebuildLayout), no layout jump occurs.
PREVENT: Any UIInputViewController API that reads host state must be deferred ≥0.3s after viewDidAppear.
